chunks: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Do you pray the voluntary prayers while sitting? He said: 'I do not pray them except while sitting, since I carried this flesh and reached this age.'
ai.seo_question: Do the Imams pray voluntary prayers while sitting?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that his practice of praying nafl while sitting is a consistent, voluntary act of worship rather than merely a concession for illness or old age, as he has maintained this posture since childhood. This establishes the permissibility and spiritual merit of sitting in voluntary prayers for the Imams, reinforcing the flexibility within Shia jurisprudence regarding prayer postures. The narration highlights the continuity of the Imam’s practice, serving as a practical model for followers to emulate ease and devotion in their daily worship.
